IDEA: TB-RQ-BEHTRANS
TITLE: Behaviour-transported tangent-bundle RQ: directed-transition prior carried as a geodesic step through every SID level in a hyperbolic negative-curvature latent
MOTIVATION: In an RQ-VAE SID the residual chain is quantized in a flat tangent space rooted at the origin, so two items that users consume in sequence land in unrelated regions of SID space whenever the encoder representation of one does not dominate the other. A generative next-item recommender then has to learn, after the fact, that certain prefixes are usually followed by certain prefixes. The problem addressed is that the quantizer itself has no notion that item i is usually followed by item j, which makes the level-1..L prefix hierarchy behaviourally arbitrary and makes prefix-level generation harder than it needs to be.
NOVELTY: Previous mechanisms here changed codebook updates (successor-weighted Frechet means), tied the curvature value to a prefix-transition score, or ranked items radially by behaviour entropy. None of them changed the space in which the residual chain is walked. This idea moves the RQ chain into the tangent bundle of a fixed negative-curvature hyperboloid: each level takes a geodesic step from the previous codeword's base point, and a directed-transition prior is parallel-transported along that chain and injected as an extra step at every level. The prior is not a loss term and not a codebook statistic; it changes which codeword argmin is taken, so the whole prefix hierarchy is jointly shaped by the transition graph and by curvature.
CHANGE: The quantizer starts each item at a base point p_0 = exp^c_0(rho * b_i) (b_i the row-normalized mean of training successors) and at level l selects the codeword minimizing the Minkowski norm of (residual at p_{l-1}) minus (parallel-transported behaviour step) minus codeword, then steps forward by exp^c_{p_{l-1}}(behaviour step + codeword). Reconstruction sums the codewords parallel-transported back to the origin, so the decoder, the token vocabulary and Stage 3 are untouched.
SPECIFICATION: Per item i with encoder output z = Enc(h_i) in T_0: x = exp^c_0(z); p_0 = exp^c_0(rho*bhat_i) with bhat_i = b_i/max(||b_i||,1e-8), b_i = sum_j P_ij * h_j (h detached); for l=1..L: d_l = (1/L) * PT^c_{0->p_{l-1}}(rho*bhat_i), r_l = log^c_{p_{l-1}}(x), k_l = argmin_k || r_l - d_l - C_l[k] ||^2_L, p_l = exp^c_{p_{l-1}}(d_l + C_l[k_l]); SID = (k_1..k_L); reconstruction zhat = sum_l PT^c_{p_{l-1}->0}(C_l[k_l]), yhat = Dec(zhat). Loss = ||yhat - y||^2 + sum_l [ ||r_l - d_l - C_l[k_l]||^2_L + beta*||r_l - d_l - sg(C_l[k_l])||^2_L ]. Hyperboloid model of dimension d+1 with Minkowski form <-,->_L = -u_0 v_0 + u.v; curvature c = 1/median_i||z_i||^2 measured once from the frozen initial encoder over the 24556 training items; rho = mean_k,l ||C_l[k]|| after the standard k-means initialisation; beta = 0.25 as in baseline.
COST: Sparse behaviour matmul of 24556 x 50 edges x d=32 latent ~ 4e7 FLOP per forward pass; manifold ops are O(L*d) per item with L=4, d=32, i.e. ~1.2e8 FLOP and ~13 MB extra activations per step at 24556 training items and 24 steps per epoch. Total estimated overhead 4-6 percent of step time, roughly one extra hour over the full 3000-epoch, 72000-step Stage 2 run on four cards; no extra Stage 3 cost because the token vocabulary, sequence length and prefix trie are identical.
HYPOTHESIS: If a directed-transition prior injected as a parallel-transported geodesic step is what makes prefixes behaviou

rally meaningful, then items with overlapping training successor sets should share level-1 and level-2 tokens noticeably more often than the baseline, geodesic reconstruction distortion should stay within 3 percent of the baseline, and Stage 3 test_recall@10 should exceed the baseline and clear 0.065 by a margin larger than the seed spread. If recall rises but prefix adjacency does not, the gain is not from the coupling; if prefix adjacency rises but recall falls, the displacement is collapsing discriminability.
RISKS: The behaviour step can push many items into one hyperbolic region and destroy level-1 discriminability, which would show as high prefix adjacency with worse recall; per-level displacement twice (p_0 and d_l) may over-bias, and both weights are fixed at rho and rho/L so the mechanism cannot soften itself; b_i is detached from h so the prior can go stale as embeddings move; long-tail items have no or few successors and fall back to the origin, so the effect may be concentrated in head items only; curvature c calibrated at initialisation may be too large after latents grow, causing near-boundary saturation; single run, no ablation, so the verdict rests on one recall number and behavioural diagnostics cannot be used to rescue it.
BEHAVIOR SIGNAL: Directed item-to-item transition prior from training sequences (row-normalized top-50 successor distribution per item, self-loops removed), materialised as a sparse matrix P and applied to the current item content embeddings.
BEHAVIOR COMPUTATION: Scan the Stage-2 training split sequences only, count directed consecutive (and window-2) co-occurrences C_ij of item i followed by item j, drop i=j, keep the 50 largest counts per row, row-normalize to P; b_i = sum_j P_ij h_j with h detached, recomputed each forward pass from the current item content embeddings so it follows the encoder while contributing no gradient; items with an empty row get b_i = 0 and therefore p_0 = origin.
LEAKAGE BOUNDARY: P is built exclusively from the Stage-2 training split, the same split whose items populate the codebooks; no validation or test interaction ever enters C_ij, b_i, the codebooks, the curvature c or the scale rho. c and rho are measured from the frozen initial encoder over the 24556 training items before the first gradient step. The SID token vocabulary and its size are identical to the baseline, so Stage 3 sees no new information about test items, and behavioural diagnostics are computed on training transitions only, never on validation or test pairs.
HYPERBOLIC OPERATOR: Fixed trainable-free negative curvature c > 0 on the (d+1)-dimensional hyperboloid, with exp^c_p and log^c_p maps, Minkowski tangent norm ||u||^2_L = <-,->_L, and parallel transport PT^c_{p->q}(u) = u + c<q,u>_L/(1 - c<p,q>_L) * (p+q) along the geodesic from p to q; the codeword norm used in the argmin is the curved (Minkowski) tangent norm, not the Euclidean one.
HYPERBOLIC LOCATION: Inside the RQ quantizer, at every level of the residual chain: the codeword assignment and the base-point update are both geodesic operations, and the reconstruction transports the selected codewords back to the origin before the decoder.
COUPLING PATH: b_i -> parallel transport to the current base point p_{l-1} -> added to the residual target before the codeword argmin -> selects k_l -> the same transported vector is stepped along the geodesic to p_l -> determines the base point of level l+1 and the reconstruction. The behaviour term changes whic

h codeword is chosen and the curved operator changes what "close" and "step" mean, so deleting b_i changes the argmin at every level and setting c = 0 replaces the geodesic step with a translation, giving a different assignment and a different codebook geometry.
COUPLING EQUATION: k_l = argmin_k || log^c_{p_{l-1}}(x) - (1/L) * PT^c_{0->p_{l-1}}(rho * b_i/||b_i||) - C_l[k] ||^2_L, with p_l = exp^c_{p_{l-1}}( (1/L) * PT^c_{0->p_{l-1}}(rho*bhat_i) + C_l[k_l] ), i.e. behaviour_term(x) enters as a curvature-dependent displacement and curved_term is the exp/log/transport pair with fixed c.
OBSERVABLES: Training-transition prefix adjacency (fraction of consecutive pairs whose two SIDs share at least one of the first two tokens) before and after; mean hyperbolic radius of items and its correlation with successor out-degree; level-wise codebook usage entropy and the fraction of items landing on each level-1 token; geodesic reconstruction distortion; and Stage 3 test_recall@10 as the only judgement.
ABLATION BEHAVIOR OFF: bhat_i is set to the zero tangent vector, so p_0 = origin and d_l = 0 at every level; the quantizer is the pure curved tangent-bundle RQ walked from the origin with the learned codebooks. Implemented as the BEH_OFF code path; not trained in this round.
ABLATION GEOMETRY OFF: c is set to 0, so exp^c and log^c reduce to identity on the tangent space and PT^c to identity transport, the Minkowski norm becomes the Euclidean norm, the chain becomes additive and the quantizer reduces to a standard RQ on the behaviour-shifted residual. Implemented as the GEO_OFF code path through the same functions with a branch that skips the manifold calls; not trained in this round.
ABLATION BOTH ON: The default run: c fixed at 1/median||z_0||^2, rho fixed at the mean initial codebook norm, transition prior from the training split applied at level 0 and at each level through the transported step; this is the only arm that is trained, 3000 Stage 2 epochs on four cards, 24 steps per epoch, then the frozen Stage 3 protocol.

Outputs: SID token tuple (k_1..k_L), reconstruction zhat in T_0, per-level quantization and commitment losses, and the diagnostic tensors (p_l, d_l, hyperbolic radii) recorded for the behavioural reports.
